newsitem.title: USA: GM to change car leasing ads - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: GM to change car leasing ads - WSJ.

text.p: General Motors Corp and three Japanese automobile manufacturers have agreed to change their print and television commercials for car leases to settle U.S. state and federal charges of misleading advertising, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.

The newspaper said the settlement obliges GM, Honda Motor Co, Mitsubishi Motors Corp and Isuzu Motors Ltd to properly disclose the actual costs of leasing a car in their commercials -- something they had allegedly not done.

Citing "officials familiar" with the settlement, it said the companies had also agreed to pay the states $1 million for the costs that they had incurred to investigate consumer complaints about their misleading commercials.
The Federal Trade Commission is to announce the settlement on Thursday, it added
Mazda Motor Corp has also reached an agreement with U.S. regulators but has yet to finish talks with a number of states, the newspaper said.
